newsitem.title: UK: Fayed Brothers plan move into television - paper.
newsitem.headline: Fayed Brothers plan move into television - paper.

text.p: The Al Fayed Brothers, owner of London's luxury Harrods department store, are planning a move into television to expand their media interests, the Sunday Times newspaper reported.
One possibility is the launch of a shopping channel allowing consumers to sample goods on offer at Harrods, the paper said.
Mohamed Al Fayed has asked Mike Hollingsworth, head of London radio station 963 Liberty, to investigate the options, the paper said.
Al Fayed's media arm, Liberty Publishing, owns the radio station and Punch magazine.

"We have been looking, and are still looking, at digital broadcasting," the Sunday Times quoted Hollingsworth as saying. "We are keen because of its possibilities in both pay-per-view and in being able to relate directly to each subscriber individually. We are very interested in the whole area."
